name: ablation-canary-one
purpose: Single-task canary for the A/B/C interface ablation (PROJECT_CONTEXT.md section 28). Validates the arms end to end before spending on the full slice.
contamination: Template:02_05 is burned development data: it was tuned on, scored, and is the frozen exact canary for the semantic-program lane. It must never be reported as held-out. It is a valid ablation task because contamination is symmetric across all three arms, so the relative comparison is unaffected.

known_reference_result.note: Sanity anchor: arm C on this task should still complete. A large deviation means the harness changed, not the interface.
